retrieved_note: Re-verified 2026-09-23 against the easypaisa Bank Ltd. Schedule of Bank Charges - Branchless Banking (July 2026 to September 2026, quarterly edition, p.4) and Retail Banking (Jul 2026 to Dec 2026 amendment, marked 'Applicable from 1st October 2026'), both at the same public-information/Schedule-of-Bank-Charges/ URLs linked from easypaisa.com.pk/schedule-of-charges/, plus the live debit-cards, Asaan Account and My Account pages. Wallet debit-card issuance fees are unchanged (Visa PKR 1,000, UnionPay PKR 999, PayPak PKR 1,000, all incl. tax; no annual fee). All three cards (Visa, UnionPay, PayPak) are wallet-linked debit cards that inherit eligibility from the underlying easypaisa mobile / digital / Asaan account. The Branchless Banking SOBC expires 30 Sep 2026; an Oct-Dec 2026 edition should be checked when published.

requirements.annual_fee_waiver_rule: No annual fee; one-time issuance fee of PKR 1,000 (incl. tax) for the easypaisa Visa Debit Card per the Branchless Banking Schedule of Bank Charges, Jul-Sep 2026.

notes: Re-verified 2026-09-23 against Branchless Banking SOBC Jul-Sep 2026 (p.4) and Retail Banking SOBC Jul-Dec 2026 amendment: issuance fee PKR 1,000 (incl. tax) and no annual fee, unchanged. Account eligibility on Asaan Account page (PKR 100 opening, CNIC, one Asaan account per CNIC) unchanged.

Default Visa-branded debit card on easypaisa wallet / digital account. One-time issuance fee PKR 1,000 (incl. tax); no annual / renewal fee published in either the Branchless Banking SOC (Jul-Sep 2026, p.4) or the Retail Banking SOC (Jul-Dec 2026 amendment).
Card requires an easypaisa mobile / digital account. New mobile account opening fee PKR 0. Asaan Account opens with PKR 100; Digital Current / Savings accounts have no published minimum balance.
CNIC is mandatory for account opening per Asaan Account page and easypaisa FAQ. NewGEN minor-account (12-17) holders are parent-supervised; standalone account holders are adults (18+).
ATM card replacement is PKR 500; not relevant to issuance economics.

gaps: Neither SOC nor the debit-cards landing page publishes an explicit minimum monthly salary or income-document requirement; modeled as null (not published).
Minimum age is not stated explicitly on the debit-cards page; inferred at 18 from the Asaan Account / mobile-account framing (NewGEN 12-17 is parent-supervised, not a standalone card holder).

Retail Banking SOBC Jul-Dec 2026 amendment (applicable from 1 Oct 2026) repeats the PKR 1,000 / 999 / 1,000 / 500 wallet-card amounts under a row labelled 'Debit Card Insurance' (likely a labelling error for issuance), and separately lists a PKR 500 per-card issuance fee for branch-banking UPI (Normal/Silver/Gold/Platinum/Corporate Gold) and PayPak cards, which are not in this pilot. Both SOBCs also list an easypaisa Visa Online (virtual) Debit Card at PKR 500, not tracked here.
